_scored_by: Repo owner, 2026-10-18 (drafted by Claude, adopted by the repo owner; decisions.md O59)

measurable_in_customer_data.rationale: Total next-year spending needs paid claims across all providers; records hold one system's charges.

actionable.rationale: Useful for budgeting and programme sizing. Must NOT be used alone to allocate care: cost-based targeting under-serves groups with less access to care (Obermeyer et al., 2019; round 004 found uninsured adults almost never flagged).

lead_time.rationale: 12-month horizon from a year of history: weeks to months to act for most patients; little lead time for events in the first weeks.

fhir_representability.rationale: A 12-month event probability maps directly onto RiskAssessment.prediction.probabilityDecimal (O3).

regulatory_posture.rationale: Financial use is outside clinical decision support, but resource-allocation use needs a documented fairness review per customer (O57).
